title: Tower Lead (Support & Operations)
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Job Description: EUC Operations Manager**
===========================================

**Role Purpose**
----------------

The EUC Operations Manager is responsible for end-to-end delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of End User Computing (EUC) services, including Workplace Engineering, Unified Messaging & Collaboration, and Unified Communications. The role ensures service excellence, stakeholder satisfaction, cost optimization, automation, and people leadership aligned to contractual and business outcomes.

**Key Service Scope**
---------------------

* Workplace Engineering: End-user devices, OS lifecycle, Intune/Endpoint Management, VDI, application packaging, patching, security baselines, zero trust support
* Unified Messaging & Collaboration: Exchange Online, Outlook, M365 core services, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams collaboration
* Unified Communications: Teams Voice, Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Audio/Video, conferencing, call quality, SBCs, telephony integrations

**Key Responsibilities – Service Delivery & Operations**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Own BAU operations across EUC towers ensuring SLA/SLO compliance
* Drive ITIL processes – Incident, Problem, Change, Major Incident, Service Request
* Ensure platform stability, performance, availability, and security
* Lead Major Incident Management and RCA with preventive actions
* Ensure CMDB accuracy and operational readiness
* Manage vendors and OEM partners with performance reviews

**Governance & Stakeholder Management**
---------------------------------------

* Act as single point of contact for EUC services for client and internal leadership
* Lead weekly/monthly service reviews, QBRs, and governance forums
* Provide data-driven reporting – SLA, CSAT, MTTR, availability, risk
* Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations

**Client & Account Management**
-------------------------------

* Build trusted advisor relationship with client stakeholders
* Translate business expectations into service outcomes
* Support account growth through service excellence, innovation, and value creation
* Participate in audits, compliance reviews, and contract adherence

**People Management & Capability Building**
-------------------------------------------

* Lead multi-tier L1/L2/L3 EUC teams
* Resource planning, onboarding, skill assessments, and succession planning
* Drive upskilling, cross-skilling, and certification plans
* Performance management, mentoring, and engagement

**Automation, Transformation & Innovation**
-------------------------------------------

* Identify automation opportunities across EUC operations (Power Platform, scripts, AI/GenAI)
* Drive shift-left, self-service, and proactive monitoring
* Reduce manual effort and improve end-user experience through automation

**Cost Optimization & Efficiency**
----------------------------------

* Drive license optimization, vendor cost control, and demand management
* Improve resource productivity and operational efficiency
* Support budget planning and forecast accuracy

**Compliance, Security & Risk Management**
------------------------------------------

* Ensure alignment with InfoSec, compliance, and regulatory requirements
* Support security incidents, audits, and vulnerability remediation
* Enforce standardization and security baselines

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* 12–15+ years in EUC / Digital Workplace operations
* Strong hands-on and governance experience with AD, Messaging-collab, Devic Mangemnet, Virtualization, and UC
* Proven experience in client-facing service delivery roles
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* ITIL, M365, Intune, Citrix or Cloud SAAS certifications preferred

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* SLA adherence and service stability
* Client satisfaction and stakeholder trust
* Reduction in incidents and manual effort through automation
* Cost efficiency and productivity improvement
* Team capability maturity and retention

------------------------

title: Operations Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Oversee day-to-day manufacturing and plant operations to ensure smooth and efficient functioning.
* Plan, organise and monitor production activities in coordination with the production team.
* Ensure production targets are achieved within defined timelines while maintaining quality standards.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Inventory teams to ensure the timely availability of raw materials and packaging materials.
* Monitor manpower utilisation, workforce productivity and shift-wise operational activities.
* Ensure effective utilisation of machinery, equipment and other production resources.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures to improve productivity.
* Monitor production costs, wastage, rejection rates and overall operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with the Quality Assurance team to ensure adherence to product quality, hygiene and food safety standards.
* Ensure proper implementation of SOPs, safety guidelines and housekeeping standards across the manufacturing facility.
* Monitor preventive maintenance activities and coordinate with the maintenance team to minimise machine downtime.
* Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Coordinate with different departments to ensure timely execution of production and dispatch plans.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce costs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in manufacturing or production operations.
* Prior experience in food processing, FMCG or manufacturing will be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, manpower management and process optimisation.
* Understanding of quality control, food safety, hygiene and manufacturing SOPs.
* Good leadership, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems.
* Ability to manage multiple operational activities independently.

**Preferred Candidate:** A hands-on operations professional with practical exposure to manufacturing plant management, production coordination and workforce handling.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Technical Lead (Support & Operations)
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

To ensure on-time resolution of escalations/complexincidents, provide technical guidance to the team and ensure positive customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Understand the Incident and the diagnostic/resolution actions attempted already by the Service Desk and any other Technology Tracks
* Use the designated or allotted communication bridge, monitoring facilities and on-call schedule from Technology tracks to facilitate immediate attention from all required parties
* Authorize any IVR message updates for Service Desk
* Work with all stakeholders to identify the workaround or resolution for the Incident
* Set expectations of all stakeholders about the timelines and permissions required for the resolution
* Send Periodic updates to the stakeholders (and if required, to the customers) through Service Desk, until the Incident is resolved
* Initiate Emergency Changes if required, mobilize cross functional teams, External Vendors and obtain approvals for the mitigation actions from all stakeholders
* Retain the Technical Observation Post (certain ad-hoc individuals who observe the service after the Incident is resolved) in order to insure that the resolution has actually resolved the Incident and that the Services have returned to their normal state
* Open Problem Tickets as per Problem Management Policy and Procedures
* Document in retrospect, the actions taken, learning and approvals in the service Management tools
* Document the new knowledge learning and any other recommendations in a Critical Incident Report and submit the report to the audience in line with the Critical Incident Management procedures.

Critical Incident Management,Incident management

title: Office/Operations Manager
description:
Incmett Global, parent company of COKO Jewellery (Zevar By COKO) is hiring an Office & Operations Manager to take full ownership of day-to-day operations — inventory, order processing, staff coordination, billing and reporting — across our warehouse and office.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Inventory management** — maintain accurate stock records in Zoho Inventory, oversee goods-receipt (GRN) for incoming stock, run periodic stock counts/reconciliation, and flag discrepancies before they become write-offs
* **Order processing** — manage fulfillment across D2C (website), B2B/wholesale and exhibition orders: picking, packing, dispatch coordination with courier partners, and order-status tracking end to end
* **Staff management** — supervise warehouse and office staff, assign daily tasks, track attendance, and make sure existing SOPs (tagging, order handling) are actually followed on the floor, not just on paper
* **Billing & invoicing** — generate and track purchase bills and sales invoices, keep GST-compliant documentation current in Zoho Books, verify vendor bills, and track payments due/paid
* **Reporting** — prepare regular reports for leadership on order status, inventory levels, pending dispatches, and vendor payments
* **Vendor coordination** — liaise with suppliers on delivery timelines, follow up on pending orders, and flag recurring vendor issues

**Who we're looking for**

* Experience in operations, inventory/warehouse management, or office administration — retail, e-commerce or D2C background preferred
* Comfortable with Zoho Inventory/Books and Excel/Google Sheets; Shopify order-management exposure is a plus
* Organized and numbers-oriented — comfortable reconciling stock counts and basic billing, not just scheduling
* Hands-on: this is a floor-and-desk role, not a purely administrative one
* Clear, reliable communicator who can manage a small team and multiple priorities at once

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in jewellery, fashion accessories, or FMCG retail
* Familiarity with GST billing and e-way bill basics

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Track Lead (Support & Operations)
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Unix and Linux Engineering

L3 Engineer | JD UNX-L3 | Positions 10

Experience 10-17 years | HCL Deutsche Bank account

HCL band 3.1 or 3.2 subject to discussion and final role mapping.

**Role purpose**
----------------

Own Unix/Linux platform designs, complex problem resolution and reusable automation. Remain hands-on with OS engineering, code review, implementation and validation across the assigned product estate.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design OS builds, hardening standards and lifecycle strategies for assigned platforms, including package, kernel, driver and hardware dependencies.
* Develop and review reusable automation for patch certification, controlled rollout and configuration consistency across large estates.
* Resolve difficult kernel, memory, I/O, networking, filesystem or clustering problems through evidence-based analysis and implemented fixes.
* Define representative lab, performance, failover and recovery tests and certify changes before production rollout.
* Engineer reductions in privileged access and manual effort through approved automation, secrets controls and auditable execution.
* Lead technical production readiness, mentor engineers and work with vendors on defects while retaining ownership of implementation and validation.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Essential skills and experience**
-----------------------------------

* 10-17 years of relevant experience with deep engineering expertise in the assigned Unix/Linux products.
* Strong OS internals and cross-layer troubleshooting, including the effects of storage, networking, virtualization and application dependencies.
* Demonstrated automation design using Ansible and Python or shell, with Git, CI/CD, tests and controlled production rollout.
* Evidence of leading complex platform upgrades, root-cause remediation and recovery/availability validation.

**Tools and technology expertise**
----------------------------------

* Core Linux lane: RHEL, SLES or Oracle Linux; rpm/dnf/yum/zypper, systemd, journalctl, LVM and filesystem diagnostics, as appropriate to the distribution.
* Primary Unix lanes, where assigned: AIX with PowerVM/LPAR tools or Solaris with ZFS and service management. Match candidates to a specific OS lane.
* Automation and diagnosis: Ansible, Python or Bash/Shell, Git, vmstat, iostat, sar and platform-appropriate network/process diagnostics.

**Preferred expertise**
-----------------------

* Experience of working with EMC and equivalent enterprise storage products
* Experience of working in RedHat cluster (pacemaker)
* Knowledge of physical infrastructure and hardware such as HP ProLiant DL380/580, and Oracle/Sun M series and other SPARC servers
* RedHat migration in place upgrade (RHEL IPU)
* Red Hat Satellite; Puppet; Jenkins/TeamCity/GitHub Actions; ansible-lint/Molecule; VCS/Veritas Volume Manager for the relevant legacy lane.

**Expected engineering outputs**
--------------------------------

* A certified OS baseline or lifecycle design with reusable automation.
* A resolved complex platform problem with evidence of improved stability or reduced manual work.

Own testing, approved implementation and validation. Follow access/change controls and protect credentials and production data.

-------------------

Unix

title: Real Estate Business Development & Operations Manager
description:
# WE ARE HIRING

## Real Estate Business Development & Operations Manager – India

\*\*Company:\*\* Dar Al Yusr Real Estate (UAE)

\*\*Job Location:\*\* India – [City / Location]

\*\*Experience:\*\* 5+ Years Preferred

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Industry:\*\* Real Estate | Property Sales | Investment | Business Development

\*\*Compensation:\*\* Fixed Monthly Salary + Attractive Sales Commission + Performance-Based Bonuses

### About Dar Al Yusr Real Estate

Dar Al Yusr Real Estate is a UAE-based real estate business preparing to expand its presence in India.

Our goal is to build strong relationships with Indian property buyers, investors, brokers, and business partners while connecting them with real estate opportunities in the UAE, particularly Dubai.

As part of this expansion, we are planning to establish an office in India and are looking for an experienced real estate professional who can help us build and grow our business.

Our recruitment and interview process in India will be coordinated by \*\*Digitech Squad Pvt. Ltd.\*\*

### About the Opportunity

We are looking for a confident, experienced, and motivated \*\*Real Estate Business Development & Operations Manager\*\* who can take responsibility for developing our India operations.

This is more than a regular real estate sales position.

We need someone who understands the property market, has strong industry connections, knows how to generate leads and close deals, and can help establish and manage a professional office.

The selected candidate will work closely with company management and UAE business partners to develop sales opportunities, manage clients, build a strong broker network, and support the company's long-term growth.

We are looking for someone who is ready to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow with the company.

### Key Responsibilities

\*\*1. Office Setup & Operations\*\*

- Help establish and organize our new office in India.

- Manage day-to-day office operations, client meetings, and business activities.

- Coordinate with company management and the UAE team.

- Help recruit, train, and manage sales executives as the business grows.

- Maintain proper client records, sales reports, and operational processes.

- Ensure the office operates professionally and efficiently.

\*\*2. Real Estate Sales & Business Development\*\*

- Generate quality leads for UAE residential and commercial properties.

- Identify potential property buyers and investors in India.

- Handle customer inquiries, property presentations, negotiations, and sales follow-ups.

- Convert qualified leads into successful property transactions.

- Develop sales strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly targets.

- Build long-term relationships with customers and investors.

- Identify new markets and opportunities for business growth.

\*\*3. Indian & UAE Real Estate Market\*\*

- Understand the Indian property market and the investment preferences of Indian buyers.

- Have good knowledge of UAE real estate, especially Dubai's property market.

- Stay informed about property developments, pricing, payment plans, and investment opportunities.

- Explain property options and buying procedures clearly to customers.

- Coordinate with UAE-based developers and authorized professionals for property availability, bookings, and transactions.

- Support customers throughout the buying process.

\*\*4. Broker, Developer & Investor Network\*\*

- Build and maintain strong relationships with real estate brokers, agents, and developers.

- Develop a reliable network of channel partners and referral sources.

- Connect with potential investors and high-value property buyers.

- Explore new partnerships that can generate business.

- Represent the company professionally in meetings, property events, and networking activities.

\*\*5. Lead Generation & Sales Management\*\*

- Develop and manage a strong pipeline of potential customers.

- Generate leads through referrals, networking, partnerships, marketing campaigns, and other sales channels.

- Maintain regular follow-ups with interested buyers.

- Track leads and sales opportunities using CRM software.

- Monitor sales performance and provide regular updates to management.

- Work towards achieving agreed sales and revenue targets.

\*\*6. Client Relationship Management\*\*

- Understand customer requirements, budgets, and investment goals.

- Recommend suitable property opportunities.

- Arrange property presentations, online meetings, and site visits where applicable.

- Maintain clear and professional communication with clients.

- Handle customer questions and concerns responsibly.

- Build trust through honest advice, transparency, and reliable service.

\*\*7. Team Leadership & Business Growth\*\*

- Help build and lead a successful real estate sales team.

- Guide employees on customer handling, lead generation, and closing techniques.

- Monitor team performance and support sales targets.

- Suggest practical ideas to improve business operations and sales.

- Take responsibility for developing the company's presence in India.

### Who We Are Looking For

\*\*Experience & Qualifications\*\*

- Minimum 5 years of experience preferred in real estate sales, brokerage, business development, or property investment.

- Strong understanding of the Indian real estate market.

- Experience or practical knowledge of UAE real estate, particularly Dubai.

- Proven experience in generating leads, negotiating, and closing property deals.

- An existing network of brokers, developers, investors, or potential property buyers is highly preferred.

- Previous experience managing a sales team, branch, or office is an advantage.

- Experience dealing with premium properties or high-value investors will be an added benefit.

\*\*Skills & Personal Qualities\*\*

- Good communication skills in English and Hindi.

- Strong negotiation and relationship-building abilities.

- Confident in dealing with customers, investors, and business partners.

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility.

- Good organizational and leadership skills.

- Comfortable using CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and sales reporting tools.

- Professional, honest, reliable, and customer-focused.

- Willing to travel for business meetings and client requirements when needed.

### Salary, Commission & Performance Bonuses

At Dar Al Yusr Real Estate, we believe that good performance and dedication deserve to be rewarded.

The selected candidate will receive a competitive compensation package consisting of:

\*\*Fixed Monthly Salary\*\*

A competitive monthly salary based on experience, skills, market knowledge, and professional capabilities.

\*\*Attractive Sales Commission\*\*

Additional commission on eligible property sales and successfully closed deals, according to the company's commission structure.

\*\*Performance-Based Bonuses\*\*

Opportunities to earn additional bonuses for achieving or exceeding agreed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

\*\*Business Growth Incentives\*\*

Additional incentives may be offered for exceptional performance, developing valuable business partnerships, and contributing significantly to the growth of our India operations.

\*\*Long-Term Career Growth\*\*

As the company expands, successful candidates will have opportunities to take on larger responsibilities, manage bigger teams, and grow into senior leadership roles.

\*\*Your earning potential will not be limited to your fixed salary. Strong sales performance can lead to higher overall earnings through commissions and bonuses.\*\*

Detailed salary, commission percentages, bonus eligibility, and payment terms will be discussed during the interview and confirmed in the employment offer.

### What We Offer

- Competitive fixed monthly salary.

- Attractive commission on successful property sales.

- Monthly, quarterly, and annual performance-based bonus opportunities.

- Additional incentives for exceptional business performance.

- Opportunity to help establish and manage our India office.

- Direct involvement with company management.

- Exposure to Indian and UAE real estate markets.

- Opportunity to develop and lead a sales team.

- Professional working environment.

- Long-term career growth based on performance.

### What We Expect From You

We are looking for someone who can take responsibility and deliver results.

You should be able to develop business opportunities, build a strong network of clients and brokers, manage sales leads, and help establish a successful office in India.

We value people who are honest, dependable, confident, and serious about their professional growth.

You do not need to come from a large real estate company. If you have worked as an independent broker, real estate agent, sales manager, or branch manager and have a strong track record, we would be happy to consider your application.

### Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to be part of a growing real estate business from an early stage of its India expansion.

You will have the chance to contribute your experience, build relationships, develop a team, and play an important role in shaping the company's operations.

We believe in long-term relationships, rewarding good performance, and giving capable people the opportunity to grow.

If you understand the real estate industry, enjoy working with clients, and have the confidence to develop and manage a business, we would like to hear from you.

### How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with the following details:

1. Total years of real estate experience.

2. Indian and UAE property markets you have worked in.

3. Current or previous designation.

4. Experience in property sales and business development.

5. Existing broker, developer, or investor network, if applicable.

6. Experience managing a team or office.

7. Current and expected salary.

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. **Designation - Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)**

**Key Expectations:**

* Process all activities related to client benefit plans with high accuracy and timeliness.

**Role Description:**

The **Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)** is responsible for processing all activities related to client benefits plans as configured in organizational tools, while consistently meeting and exceeding client SLAs.

The role requires developing a strong understanding of client plan provisions, identifying opportunities for knowledge enhancement, and delivering work to high standards of quality and timeliness. The BOA is expected to prioritize work effectively, respond to client and participant needs in a timely manner, and ensure that all knowledge repositories, SOPs, and supporting documentation are current and accurate.

The incumbent conducts research, resolves, and responds to participant issues and inquiries using the case management tool, and collaborates closely with Customer Service, Technology, and other shared services teams for timely issue resolution.

Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

**Our commitment to Inclusion:**

We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.

At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.

**Job Description**

The position will lead the enterprise Application Configuration Management and Drift Governance program supporting regulatory and cyber risk remediation initiatives. This role will be responsible for governing application security baselines, configuration compliance, drift monitoring, enterprise-wide patch governance, exception management and executive reporting.  
  
The individual will work closely with Application CDOs, Information Security, Vulnerability Management, Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, ServiceNow, CMDB, and Technology Governance teams to drive configuration hardening, baseline compliance, continuous monitoring of application configuration controls, patch compliance oversight, audit evidence readiness, and scalable governance designs for future configuration management processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Application Configuration Management and Drift Governance program across enterprise applications.
* Establish governance processes for configuration baseline creation, review, approval, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Own and manage the ongoing enterprise patch audit governance process on a day-to-day basis once the operating model transitions into BAU.
* Establish and run enterprise-wide patch governance routines, including audit scheduling, compliance tracking, escalation management, evidence collection, and reporting across technology teams.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, vulnerability management, and technology governance teams to ensure patch compliance gaps are reviewed, tracked, remediated, or risk accepted in line with enterprise policy and SLA expectations.
* Develop governance playbooks and repeatable control designs that can be extended from patch audit governance into future configuration management and configuration drift processes.
* Partner with Application CDOs and Information Security teams to identify applications eligible for configuration drift governance.
* Drive onboarding of applications into Configuration Drift Management phases including Baseline Documentation, Verification Capability, and Compliance Reporting.
* Govern application configuration compliance against approved baselines, enterprise security standards, vendor recommendations, and industry frameworks.
* Manage configuration exceptions, risk acceptance reviews, remediation tracking, and issue escalation.
* Monitor configuration drift trends and ensure timely remediation of identified gaps.
* Define and track KPIs, KRIs, compliance metrics, coverage metrics, and remediation SLAs.
* Define patch governance KPIs and KRIs covering audit completion, patch compliance, overdue remediation, exception ageing, SLA adherence, and control effectiveness.
* Prepare executive dashboards and governance reports for technology and cyber risk leadership.
* Coordinate regulatory, audit, and compliance evidence requests related to configuration governance.
* Collaborate with ServiceNow, CMDB, Vulnerability Management, and Technology Governance teams to improve governance maturity and reporting automation.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen enterprise configuration compliance and cyber resilience.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering or related field; or equivalent work experience.
* 8-12 years of relevant experience required.
* Ability to communicate and articulate technical information across various organizational levels.
* Strong thought leadership abilities and a highly innovative problem solver.
* High reasoning aptitude and ability to quickly understand a complex operating environments.
* Ability to coach and mentor experienced engineering staff.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of Application Configuration and Patch Management, Configuration Compliance, and Drift Governance.
* Experience in Cybersecurity Governance, Risk Management, Vulnerability Management, or Technology Controls.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, CMDB, Governance Reporting, and Workflow Management.
* Knowledge of SaaS, COTS, Custom Applications, Cloud Platforms, and Enterprise Technology Environments.
* Familiarity with CIS Benchmarks, NIST Framework, Secure Configuration Standards, and Compliance Monitoring.
* Experience supporting regulatory remediation, audit reviews, and risk governance programs.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience building dashboards, metrics, KPI/KRI reporting, and governance scorecards.
* Knowledge of automation tools, configuration validation, and drift detection concepts.

The incumbent conducts research, resolves, and responds to participant issues and inquiries using the case management tool, and collaborates closely with Customer Service, Technology, and other shared services teams for timely issue resolution.
